items.label: Introduction
items.content:
# Introduction

**Overview:**
AIClient allows browser-based AI text and image generation. No build step required; simple script inclusion is enough.

**Include the library:**
```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/HyperRushNet/hrn-ai/client/1.0.3.min.js"></script>
```

**Notes:**
- `client` is globally accessible.
- Only for browser use.
- Lightweight and dependency-free.

items.label: Initialize Client
items.content:
# Initialize

**Essence:**
Authenticate with your API key before using AIClient.

**Code:**
```javascript
client.setApiKey('YOUR_API_KEY');
```

**Tips:**
- Store your API key securely.
- Only call once per session.
- All future calls automatically use this key.

items.label: Set Text Type
items.content:
# Set Type

**Essence:**
Configure AIClient to generate text.

**Code:**
```javascript
client.setType('text');
```

**Tips:**
- Always call before model or generate.
- 'text' is required for all text generation operations.

items.label: Choose Text Model
items.content:
# Set Model

**Essence:**
Pick a model for your text output. Models vary in speed, style, and creativity.

**Code:**
```javascript
client.setModel('flux');
```

**Links:**
- [Models Page](https://enter.pollinations.ai/#:~:text=Models)
- [Model Health](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai/)

**Tips:**
- Select based on your text type (story, assistant, code, etc.).

items.label: Generate Text
items.content:
# Generate

**Essence:**
Send a prompt to generate text and handle the output.

**Code:**
```javascript
const prompt = 'Write a motivational quote about AI.';
const output = await client.generate(prompt);
console.log(output);
```

**Tips:**
- Await the result for async behavior.
- Prompt quality strongly affects results.

items.label: Optional Functions
items.content:
# Optional Functions

**Essence:**
Enhance text generation using additional functions. Each option is a sub-step:

## setSystemPrompt
```javascript
client.setSystemPrompt('You are a helpful assistant.');
```
- Sets the AI’s persona.

## setTimeout
```javascript
client.setTimeout(30000);
```
- Maximum request time in ms.

## setRetry
```javascript
client.setRetry(true, 2, 1000);
```
- Retry failed requests with count and delay.

items.label: Set Image Type
items.content:
# Set Type

**Essence:**
Configure AIClient to generate images.

**Code:**
```javascript
client.setType('image');
```

**Tips:**
- Always set type before any image calls.

items.label: Choose Image Model
items.content:
# Set Model

**Essence:**
Select a model specialized for images. Some models focus on photorealistic, stylized, or abstract outputs.

**Code:**
```javascript
client.setModel('flux');
```

**Links:**
- [Models Page](https://enter.pollinations.ai/#:~:text=Models)
- [Model Health](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai/)

**Tips:**
- Pick a model that fits your image style needs.

items.label: Generate Image
Optional Functions
items.content:
# Optional Functions

**Essence:**
Enhance image generation with fine-tuned options. Each function is a sub-tab:

## setDimensions
```javascript
client.setDimensions(1024, 1024);
```
- Width and height in pixels.

## setTimeout
```javascript
client.setTimeout(30000);
```
- Maximum generation time.

## setRetry
```javascript
client.setRetry(true, 2, 1000);
```
- Retry failed requests automatically.
